name: send_demo_confirmation
description: Call this only while in the Ryan/Summit Roofing demo persona, after the caller has agreed to a fictional inspection time and opted in to a confirmation. Sends a REAL SMS (and email if given) confirming that fictional appointment — this is real and lands on the caller's actual phone, unlike book_appointment which must never be called in this persona.

full_name.description: Caller's full name, confirmed by readback

phone.description: The real caller's phone number in E.164 format. Must be either the resolved {{caller_number}} value or a number the caller actually stated and you confirmed digit-by-digit — never a placeholder or invented number.

email.description: Caller's email if they gave one, confirmed by letter-by-letter readback. Omit this field entirely if they didn't want to give an email.

appointment_label.description: Short natural description of the fictional appointment, e.g. 'free roof inspection this Thursday at 10am'
